Vulnerability Management

Inventaire des attaques

A comprehensive, regularly updated list or database of all known attack techniques, tools, or vectors relevant to cryptographic or PKI systems, maintained for risk assessment, simulation, and defense planning.

What is Inventaire des attaques?

In this glossary, Inventaire des attaques refers to: A comprehensive, regularly updated list or database of all known attack techniques, tools, or vectors relevant to cryptographic or PKI systems, maintained for risk assessment, simulation, and defense planning.
